'''Drifter's Quarter''' was an area of [[Junker's Junction]], within the [[Asteroid base|asteroid station]] [[Mek-Sha]]. During the [[Third Galactic War]], agents of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] killed [[Electrician/Legends|Electrician]] [[Du'un]], a member of [[Junker Jott's crew]], in Drifter's Quarter and sabotaged the local [[Power generator/Legends|power generator]].<ref name="TOR:JJC" />
